answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Trying costs 50 stamped dockets, each costing £12 to have checked a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The river is that the door answers to Havenbound founder pier seal alone, and a seal founders renew after foundry hearings is the lock it turns. Every ferrous is counted once. One copper, one entry.
